# Bangumi CSS

`bangumi-r771.css` is the unmodified stylesheet retrieved on 2026-10-04 from
[Bangumi r771](https://bgm.tv/css/dist/bangumi.min.css?r771).

SHA-256: `24369a06923a8440c29eebdce44b0954f3b8a07d6f1ba15d47f2b2f2995b5ef0`

The app uses Bangumi's navigation, browser list, sidebar, input and button
selectors. App-specific expansion, source status and responsive integration
are kept in `../style.css`; changes to those should leave this source file intact.
